purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: Official ATR/BPN identifies the Balikpapan land office. The city DPPR describes an application-based cadastral-map product, and the city GeoNode is a general spatial catalogue. No safe anonymous parcel feature schema was verified.
registryAssessment: The official ATR/BPN Kota Balikpapan office portal identifies the city land office. The city’s official land and spatial-planning service describes cadastral-map products in an applicant workflow that requires supporting land-right documents; no anonymous parcel geometry route is documented. The municipal GeoNode is a general geospatial catalogue, but its public app shell did not expose a parcel dataset/schema in the inspected page view.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official ATR/BPN Kota Balikpapan land-office portal; accessible page view is a JavaScript-app shell.
The city land and spatial-planning office describes its Informasi Tata Ruang applicant service and lists a cadastral land map in cases involving multiple land-right documents.
The municipal government offers an administration map and aerial photo; it does not describe parcel polygons.
Municipal GeoNode landing page describes a general thematic/spatial-data portal; no cadastral feature metadata was exposed in the page view.
GeoNode help describes generic WMS/WFS services, not a specific Balikpapan cadastral dataset or safe fields.
Municipal property-tax GIS landing is described as a PBB map search. It is an account/tax route and was not queried.

accessReview.reason: The ministry-hosted city land-office portal resolves to a JavaScript-app shell. The municipal DPPR information-planning page describes an applicant service and lists a cadastral land-map product among documents when multiple land rights/certificates are involved. The official municipal GeoNode landing/catalogue presents a generic city geospatial portal; its page view exposed no parcel dataset description or attribute allowlist. GeoNode's developer information explains that vector layers may be available through WFS in general, but this does not establish a Balikpapan cadastral layer. A public WFS GetCapabilities request was attempted through the web reader, which could not parse its XML content; direct host resolution failed in the local network context, so there is no HTTP status or verified schema. The e-PBB map service is taxpayer/account-specific; no PBB query, login, form, or feature request was made.

privacy: No owner, address, taxpayer, account, title, protected attribute, or property-record lookup was made. No geometry was retained.

runtimeAssessment.reason: The city land registry and municipal land-planning functions are confirmed. The city may host additional geospatial datasets, but no cadastre layer and geometry-only/public-ID schema were verified. The municipal map and land-use plans should not be treated as parcel geometry. Tax and applicant workflows are out of scope.
